question: Which instrument was played by Ustad Asad Ali Khan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rudra Veena**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Asad Ali Khan** was a renowned Indian musician known for playing the **Rudra Veena**.
 
• The **Rudra Veena** is an ancient string instrument and is considered one of the most important veenas in Indian classical music.
 
• Ustad Asad Ali Khan was one of the last living masters of this instrument and contributed significantly to its preservation and promotion.
 
• He belonged to the Jaipur Beenkar Gharana, a tradition that specializes in the Rudra Veena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Asad Ali Khan** received numerous awards and accolades for his contribution to Indian classical music, including the prestigious **Padma Bhushan** in 2008.
 
• The **Rudra Veena** is a complex instrument to master, requiring years of dedicated practice and deep understanding of Indian classical music.
 
• Ustad Asad Ali Khan's performances were known for their depth, spiritual intensity, and technical proficiency.
